an10.65:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sāriputto magadhesu, viharati nālakagāmake.
an10.65:1.2: atha kho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
an10.65:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca.
an10.65:2.1: kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta sukhaṃ kiṃ dukkhanti.
an10.65:2.2: abhinibbatti kho āvuso dukkhā, anabhinibbatti sukhā.
an10.65:2.3: abhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ.
an10.65:2.4: sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo aggisamphasso daṇḍasamphasso satthasamphasso ñātipi mittāpi saṅgamma samāgamma rosenti.
an10.65:2.5: abhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ.
an10.65:2.6: anabhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ.
an10.65:2.7: na sītaṃ na uṇhaṃ na jighacchā na pipāsā na uccāro na passāvo na aggisamphasso na daṇḍasamphasso na satthasamphasso ñātipi mittāpi saṅgamma samāgamma na rosenti.
an10.65:2.8: anabhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhanti.
